title: Centerra Gold Announces Results of 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders
summary: TORONTO, May 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Centerra Gold Inc. (TSX: CG) (NYSE: CGAU) (Centerra or the Company) announces the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders (the Meeting) held on May 5, 2026. A total of 152,456,607 shares, representing 76.39% of common shares issued and outstanding, were represented at the Meeting. Detailed voting results are outlined below. Election of Directors Each of the nominee directors listed in Centerras management information circular dated March 20, 2026, was elected.
